Title: General Availability – Database Schema Conversion Toolkit for Oracle

Body.Content:
The Database Schema Conversion Toolkit for Oracle extension in the Azure Data Studio marketplace is a tool that automates the conversion of various database objects from an Oracle-compliant format to the Azure SQL T-SQL (Transact-SQL) format. These conversions include tables, indexes, views, procedures, and triggers. The goal of this tool is to simplify and accelerate the migration journey from Oracle to Azure SQL.

Learn more
